reuse.why: Uses the tree's shared isDailyWeekendSkip and applyWeekendRule helpers plus recurConfigToRSchedule, the same ones getUpcomingDates and getNextDate use.

duplication.why: Weekend rule itself is shared; only the small daily-skip isWeekend filter dispatch and the RSchedule/try/captureBreadcrumb scaffold mirror getUpcomingDates.

placement.why: Handler sits beside getUpcomingDates in server/schedules/app.ts and is registered alongside it.

scope.why: Handler, registration, tests and a release note only.

maintainability.why: A change to the weekend rule flows through the shared helpers; the forEach with early returns is slightly awkward but clear.

bypasses_abstraction.where: getDatesInRange calls isDailyWeekendSkip and applyWeekendRule rather than going around them.

disguised_duplication.where: The remaining overlap with getUpcomingDates (daily isWeekend filter branch) is the same thin dispatch around shared helpers, not hidden logic.
